clips.text: Welcome to the Bali massive. Somewhere past the rice terraces, a dead signal just found a live one.
Bali massive. The geckos are up, and so are we. Dead Internet Radio, still transmitting.
Indonesia, you're on the frequency. Seventeen thousand islands, one dead signal.
London, you've tuned in. Somewhere under all that grey, the last radio station on Earth says hello.
Hello to the United Kingdom. Put the kettle on. The internet's been dead for years.
New York. The city that never sleeps just found the station that never stops.
Los Angeles, the signal reached the coast. Palm trees, smog, and dead air. Welcome.
Hello, America. Fifty states, one dead network, and you just tuned in.
Berlin, welcome to the transmission. The club closed. The signal didn't.
Germany is on the dial. Precise, punctual, and slightly haunted. Welcome.
Amsterdam, you're locked in. Canals, bicycles, and a radio station run by ghosts.

Australia, you're upside down and dialled in. The signal took the long way round to find you.

It's Friday night where you are, and you chose dead radio. Excellent choice.
A slow Sunday, and someone new on the line. The signal moves gently today.
Welcome back. The signal remembered you. It always does.
You came back. Most people don't. The dead internet appreciates loyalty.
Back again, and at this hour. You and the machines, keeping each other company.
Regular listener detected. At this point, you're part of the broadcast.

Welcome to the listener on the small screen. A whole dead internet, right there in your pocket.

Someone sent you here. Good. The signal only spreads by word of mouth now.
Call sign confirmed. You're on the chat, and now you're on the air. Welcome.
